title: Narrative bind (story lock before DCF)
description: Story + carrier map + evidence_hooks + stage_fit. Harness >= 3.4.0: written by the 1e story specialist only. Lock is narrative_3p.verdict=PASS, not this file's status. Identity lives on classification.json. Agent 5 must not write this file. Older stamps: Agent 5 wrote it before valuation_model.json; status=locked was the compute-bind gate.

status.description: Legacy < 3.4.1 lock field. On >= 3.4.1 lock is narrative_3p.verdict=PASS; status is optional.

life_cycle_stage.description: REQUIRED on harness 3.3.0–3.3.x (Python gate). On >= 3.4.0 identity lives on classification.json.

who_leads.description: REQUIRED on harness 3.3.0–3.3.x (Python gate). On >= 3.4.0 identity lives on classification.json.

stage_fit.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.3.0 (Python gate) when a stage is named: why the story matches the stage. A wrong-stage story is a fail, not a variant.

buyer.description: REQUIRED on harness 3.3.0–3.3.x (Python gate). On >= 3.4.0 buyer class lives on classification.json; compute dials on valuation_model.buyer_dials. The marginal buyer. public_diversified/ipo_or_public_buyer: illiquidity_discount must be 0. private_undiversified: total_beta=true and illiquidity_discount>0. vc_pe: ke_stepdown.

illiquidity_discount.description: Fraction of value. 0 for a diversified public buyer; >0 for a private undiversified buyer.

ke_stepdown.description: REQUIRED for vc_pe (>=20 chars): how cost of equity steps down toward the market at recap/IPO.

market_contest.description: REQUIRED on harness 3.3.0–3.3.x (Python gate). On >= 3.4.0 market_contest lives on classification.json.

option_screens.description: REQUIRED when classification.iv_playbook is contingent_claim or overlays include real_options. 1e story writes this on the bind. Opportunities are not options.

distressed_call.description: REQUIRED when classification.overlays includes distressed_call. 1e story writes this on the bind. The liquidation call replaces DCF equity; it is never added on top.

iv_playbook.description: REQUIRED on harness 3.1.0–3.3.x (Python gate). On >= 3.4.0 the primary id lives on classification.json.

overlays.description: Stacked overlays: cyclical | distressed | intangibles_sbc | em | truncation | sotp_users | growth_assets | macro_neutral | real_options | distressed_call | asset_based_floor | private_buyer | value_enhancement. Overlays do not replace the one primary iv_playbook.

story.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0 (Python gate). paragraph states the business story (>=20 chars).

3p.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0. possible/plausible/probable must each be a non-empty list; possible strands are not in the DCF base.

map.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0. >= 3.4.0 keys are story carriers (tam, share_path, slice, target_om, tax_path, sales_to_capital, kc_path, p_fail, tv_form, stable_roc_vs_kc); Agent 5 maps them onto model fields via valuation_model.story_input_bind. < 3.4.0 keys named real valuation_model inputs.

evidence_hooks.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.4.0. Map or reject each material FDD / operating-path / background finding. action is map|reject; noted_only is illegal.
